title: corydalis benecincta subsp. trilobipetala
intro: Corydalis benecincta subsp. trilobipetala, commonly known as the Three-lobed Corydalis or Yan Hu suo, is a plant species in the family Papaveraceae. It is a traditional medicinal plant used in Chinese medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, anti-anxiety, and anti-depressant properties. The therapeutic actions of Corydalis benecincta subsp. trilobipetala include analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and sedative effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, particularly tetrahydropalmatine (THP) and protopine. These bioactive compounds are believed to contribute to the plant's therapeutic actions, although further research is needed to fully understand its pharmacological mechanisms.
